name: text_area_06_android
description: 06_text_area —— 用 gpui-android 后端在手机跑多行文本框（命令入口，IDE 会显示运行按钮）

scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='package.json';const c='Cargo.toml';const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));let [maj,min,pat]=j.version.split('.').map(Number);pat++;j.version=[maj,min,pat].join('.');fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n');const t=fs.readFileSync(c,'utf8').replace(/^version = ".*"$/m,'version = "'+j.version+'"');fs.writeFileSync(c,t);console.log('bumped to v'+j.version);"
scripts.android:run: bun run android:init && bun run android:apk && bun run android:install && bun run android:launch
